_: Riverwalk life-group and household sheet (2.5c), from the place record's life block.

entries.name: The boat crew lodging at the stage

norms.text: The crew poles the raft along the channel to the stage.
The best bunk in the crews' house goes to whoever wins it at Shells and Stones.
Evenings in the crews' house go on Shells and Stones.

values.text: A dry bunk and a fed belly.

contempts.text: The toll, paid at every crossing into the pilgrim water.

faction.text: The toll comes out of the crew's share, whoever ends up with it.

place.text: The best bunks on the coast are here.

work.text: Poling is honest work if the stroke is kept.

addressTerms.text: Pole-hand, for any stranger who looks able.
The crew is called by its raft, the Slow Heron, as the stage calls every crew by its boat; the three answer to 'Slow Heron' and hail other crews by their boats.

grievances.text: Two claimants on one toll means the crews pay for the argument.
